problem: Find $a\cdot (b\times c)$ given that $a=⟨1,0,2⟩$ and $b\times c=⟨-2,1,8⟩.$
worked_solution:
Substituting given vectors into the formula for the scalar triple product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot (b\times c) & =⟨1,0,2⟩\cdot ⟨-2,1,8⟩ \\  & =1\cdot (-2)+0\cdot 1+2\cdot 8 \\  & =14.\end{aligned}
$$
